mapper.select: select case when degree = 1 then '本科' when degree = 2 then '大专' when degree = 3 then '高中' when degree = 4 then '初中' when degree = 5 then '小学' else '其他' end name ,count(*) value from student group by degree
select clazz.name name,count(*) value from student left join clazz on clazz.id=student.clazz_id group by clazz.name
select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') month, count(*) value from student where create_time is not null group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') order by month
select s.name, s.violation_count count, s.violation_score score, c.name clazzName from student s left join clazz c on c.id = s.clazz_id where s.violation_count > 0 order by s.violation_score desc

select (select count(*) from emp) empCount, (select count(*) from student) stuCount, (select count(*) from clazz) clazzCount, (select count(*) from dept) deptCount, (select coalesce(sum(violation_count), 0) from student) totalViolation, (select coalesce(sum(violation_score), 0) from student) totalViolationScore
